## Summary of Changes
Provide a concise overview of what this pull request changes and why.

## Motivation & Context
- Fixes #(issue)
- Implements RFC / feature: ...

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Vendor mapping pack addition or update
- [ ] Refactoring / performance improvement (no API changes)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] Solution builds cleanly: `dotnet build Atlas.slnx`
- [ ] All automated tests pass: `dotnet test Atlas.slnx`
- [ ] Code formatting verified: `dotnet format Atlas.slnx --verify-no-changes`
- [ ] Local verification runner passes: `./scripts/verify.ps1` (or `./scripts/verify.sh`)
- [ ] New unit/integration tests added covering new behavior

## Confidentiality & Clean Identity Checklist
- [ ] No personal names, usernames, or email addresses committed.
- [ ] No customer, employer, or proprietary plant identifiers included.
- [ ] Illustrative fixtures use generic names (e.g. `Atlas`, `ExampleMachine`, `DemoController`).
